name: Elizabeth
title: Mother of John the Baptist
summary: Elizabeth was of Aaron's lineage and married to the priest Zechariah. She was barren until old age, but the angel Gabriel announced that she would give birth to John the Baptist. When Mary visited, the baby leaped in Elizabeth's womb, and she was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied over Mary.

keyEvents.title: Righteous but Childless
keyEvents.description: Elizabeth and Zechariah were both righteous before God, yet they were childless and advanced in years.

keyEvents.title: The Angel's Message
keyEvents.description: The angel Gabriel appeared to Zechariah in the temple and announced that Elizabeth would give birth to a son named John.

keyEvents.title: Mary's Visit
keyEvents.description: When Mary visited, the baby leaped in Elizabeth's womb, and she was filled with the Spirit and cried out: 'Blessed are you among women!'

keyEvents.title: The Birth of John
keyEvents.description: Elizabeth gave birth to a son, and the neighbors rejoiced with her over God's mercy.

keyEvents.title: The Naming
keyEvents.description: At the circumcision, relatives wanted to name the child Zechariah, but Elizabeth insisted: 'No, he shall be called John.'
